messages:
Maya (CS): Quick sync  Mirage submitted a vendor questionnaire and they're asking for SOC2 control mapping + our deletion workflow. Renewal flagged as at-risk until answered.
Oliver (Security): I saw the form. Missing are: CC5 (system operations) evidence and explicit deletion SLA. They want an illustration of how user data is erased across services.
Rina (Legal): Deletion SLA ask: they want 7-day completion. Our standard is 30 days; need to confirm if we can commit to 7 days for certain classes.
Sam (Engineering): 7 days for full deletion including backups? That's tough. We can guarantee immediate removal from active DBs and exports within 48 hours, but backups are a different story. We could offer a policy: 48h active delete + 14d backup purge for special contracts.
Maya (CS): They need an answer before the renewal call next week. Can we do a 15-min triage now and capture artifacts?
Oliver (Security): I'll prepare CC5 artifacts and a sequence diagram for deletion flow.
Rina (Legal): I'll propose a two-option SLA: (A) Standard 30-day full purge, (B) Accelerated 14-day purge with additional fees/constraints and BYOK not required.
Sam (Engineering): I'll outline the technical limits and what we can do immediately. Also noting: log retention might remain at 90 days.
triage-bot: Case CS-5012 status -> triage_in_progress
Maya (CS): Scheduling triage for 11:15am PT. Invite sent to Mirage security.
Oliver (Security): Uploaded CC5 artifacts and a deletion sequence diagram to CS-5012. Link: https://rwd-internal/cs/CS-5012/evidence
Rina (Legal): Draft SLA options uploaded.
Sam (Engineering): Tech note uploaded: "Deletion semantics & backup handling".
Maya (CS): After triage: Mirage accepted option B (14-day accelerated purge) with an additional SOC attestation for CC5 within 5 business days. We're closing the loop; health back to green pending attestation. I'll add to renewal notes.
Oliver (Security): I'll follow up to get the attestation template signed.
Rina (Legal): I'll update the DPA appendix to reflect option B and route to exec for sign-off.
Maya (CS): Thanks all. Tagging CS-5012 for final artifacts and closing when the attestation is uploaded. :white_check_mark:
